recentItems.title: NFL Players & Military Heroes on the Power of Brotherhood | The Mosquito Bowl | Netflix
recentItems.description:
Different uniforms. Same brotherhood.

From the football field to the battlefield, the bonds forged through teamwork, trust, and sacrifice run deep. NFL players and military service members reflect on the powerful meaning of brotherhood, the importance of having each other’s backs, and the unbreakable connections that unite those who fight for something bigger than themselves.

Inspired by the extraordinary true story of four college football stars who traded the gridiron for the Marines during World War II, The Mosquito Bowl celebrates the enduring power of brotherhood, both on and off the field.

The Mosquito Bowl is in theaters now and on Netflix November 25.

recentItems.title: Permafrost | Official Trailer | Netflix
recentItems.description:
Two unlikely partners. Two separate investigations. And one plot to sabotage the Nobel Banquet.

When a pair of seemingly unrelated investigations begin to overlap, Marcus Tell (Björn Gustafsson) and Ann Wilding (Aliette Opheim) find themselves reluctantly teaming up. With their differences causing as much friction as the case itself, the two officers are drawn into a fast-moving mission to stop a plot targeting the Nobel Banquet.

Permafrost is set to premiere globally on Netflix on December 10, 2026.
